oppRadar.title: Fannie Mae SEL-2026-09 (Oct 7) loosens verbal-VOE and K-1 income rules
oppRadar.body: Fannie Mae published Selling Guide Announcement SEL-2026-09 on October 7, 2026. Per the announcement page it removes the requirement to use specific verbal verification-of-employment methods, clarifies qualifying with Schedule K-1 income under 25%, updates income-continuance and employment-offer/contract delivery rules, widens attorney-opinion-letter and right-of-first-refusal eligibility, and replaces the PDF Form 482 process with a self-service application. Effective dates per the official document (search-indexed page only; full text not opened).

oppRadar.title: 30-yr fixed at 7.40% (Oct 8 PMMS) — highest since Nov 2023, seventh straight weekly rise
oppRadar.body: Trading Economics' October 8, 2026 summary of Freddie Mac's PMMS puts the 30-year fixed at 7.40%, the highest since November 2023 and the seventh consecutive weekly increase; the October 1 survey was 7.28% (6.34% a year earlier), with the 15-year at 6.60%. The driver cited across sources is the 10-year Treasury above 5% on inflation concerns. Freddie Mac's own Oct 8 release was not opened; confirm at freddiemac.com/pmms before quoting.

oppRadar.title: Fed minutes (Oct 7): another 2026 hike likely, but an October hold now favored
oppRadar.body: Scotsman Guide reported that the September FOMC minutes, released around October 7, 2026, show most participants expect another increase in the fed funds target by year-end, after the September hike to 3.75%-4.00%. Reporting dated Oct 6 and the prior week shows October 27-28 hike odds falling to roughly 17-26% with December favored, after a weak 29,000-job September payrolls print. Odds figures conflict by source and date — treat as direction, not a number.

oppRadar.title: VA 30-yr rates cross 7% (7.07% on Oct 7 per Optimal Blue via VA Loan Network)
oppRadar.body: VA Loan Network (a lender marketing site, Oct 7, 2026) reports the 30-year fixed VA rate averaged 7.07% on October 7, up from 6.45% on September 8, citing Optimal Blue via CNBC Select; CNBC Select separately showed about 7.08% VA on Oct 1. Single-sourced for the Oct 7 figure. No VA circular dated October 2026 was found; VA's partial-claim program still carries a November 28, 2026 servicer implementation deadline.

Lennar's Inland Empire Broker Loyalty Referral Program pays agents $10K/$14K/$18K (up to $42K) for 1st/2nd/3rd closings on select homes under purchase agreements signed 03/24/26-02/15/27 and funded by 02/28/27; a separate undated Lennar IE page advertises a promotional FHA fixed 4.375% (5.124% APR) or conventional 4.625% (4.873% APR) requiring Lennar Mortgage.
